test_notes.title: Database Architecture Decision
test_notes.content: We chose PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy 2 for the backend and SQLite for mobile. Alembic handles production migrations.

test_notes.title: Flutter State Management
test_notes.content: Riverpod StateNotifier was selected over raw setState and Provider because of compile-safe dependency injection.
